purpose: Collect business listing submissions for directory or editorial-team review.

fields.label: Safari URL
fields.accessibility_notes: Visible optional label with URL validation.

fields.label: Logo Upload
fields.accessibility_notes: Visible label; allowed file types listed. SVG should be reviewed before allowing.

conditional_logic.rule: optional; require review before copying to Media Library

confirmations.name: Default
confirmations.message: Thanks. Your listing has been submitted for review.

notifications.name: Directory owner notification
notifications.message: Include entry link, category, area, and listing summary. Do not attach uploads unless approved.

feeds.name: Optional Advanced Post Creation listing draft feed
feeds.condition: Only after listing post type, taxonomies, custom fields, media handling, and Draft/Pending Review status are approved.

spam_settings.turnstile: consider for public forms if available

accessibility_settings.label_guidance: No placeholder-only fields; keep category labels explicit.

data_retention_notes: Listing entries contain business contact personal data, consent records, and optional uploaded brand assets. Consent wording, directory-team access, export/erase handling, and retention must be confirmed before launch.
required_addons: Advanced Post Creation only if draft listing creation is approved
risks: Public directory submissions require editorial review.
Do not let submitters create arbitrary taxonomy terms without approval.
Logo uploads require file type, security, rights, and media-library review.
